channel.title: The Chatham Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Chatham Daily News (chathamdailynews.ca)

item.title: Accused killer of Milton woman has died, Chatham court hears
item.description: Sky-Linn Holden, 25, was to appear Tuesday by video, but court heard she has died.

item.title: Musical comedy coming to St. Andrew’s
item.description: Four performances of the long-standing comedy, I Love You, You’re Perfect, Now Change: The Musical, will be coming to St. Andrew’s.

item.title: Renoviction motion passed, report and draft bylaw to come
item.description: With a large crowd in the chamber, a Chatham councillor's motion aimed at stemming renovictions took the next step Monday night.

item.title: Pain Court swimmers win multiple LKSSAA races
item.description: Pain Court’s Gavin Schinkelshoek won three events while teammates Harrison Walsh, Jack Harrigan and Xavier Caron each won two at the LKSSAA swim meet.

item.title: Local roundup: Ballhawks win bronze; Blades set team records; Wild lose preview
item.description: Two Chatham Ballhawks boys teams won bronze medals at Ontario Volleyball Association tournaments on the weekend.

item.title: Accused killer, 25, who died in custody had hopes for future, mom says
item.description: Though Sky-Linn Holden was facing a murder charge, she had hopes for the future, including reuniting with her two young children, her mother says.

item.title: Ursuline Lancers, CKSS Golden Hawks in LKSSAA girls volleyball final
item.description: The Ursuline Lancers and Chatham-Kent Golden Hawks are set for their annual matchup in the LKSSAA senior girls AAA volleyball championship after posting semifinal sweeps Tuesday.

item.title: Venue change for Chatham murder trial surprise to family of victim
item.description: The family of Henry Neudorf were surprised to learn the trial for the woman facing a first-degree murder in his death has been moved to London.
